sections.heading: Virtual Depictions
sections.body: Refik Anadol's media wall was dedicated on 30 September 2015 and runs a twelve-chapter, ninety-minute programme with eight-channel sound on a screen 20 by 40 feet. On 6 September 2024 a pane of glass fell from the roof of the building and damaged the Millennium Tower next door.

historical_record.description: A commercial building, heavily altered since.

Built in 1923 to the design of George Applegarth for the Cebrian Company, a family real estate firm, as a speculative venture; textile firms such as the pattern-maker Butterick Company and publishers' offices such as the MacMillan Company took space in it. It was cleared for the office tower of 2015.
